events.event: The Supreme Court (MA), in cassation case 742/K/TUN/2026 filed by HM Subhan, reportedly granted the suit and declared invalid the SMA equivalency certificate (suket penyetaraan) that Vice President Gibran used as a 2024 candidacy requirement.
events.key_numbers: Case 742/K/TUN/2026 · ruling read/notified via e-court Fri 30 Oct 2026 · plaintiff HM Subhan asked for the suket to be declared invalid and withdrawn from Kemendikdasmen's Dirjen Dikdasmen · MA spokesperson Yanto had not yet confirmed · full ruling text not yet published
events.why_it_matters: A second court has now weighed in on the VP's diploma paper, raising the question of what it means for his position.
events.spreading_evidence: Top of detik berita page; CNN, Kompas, Suara, Bloomberg Technoz all covering 30-31 Oct

events.event: Parties and officials react to the MA ruling on Gibran's suket: PKB says it will base political steps on the MK and MA rulings; PDIP reportedly discusses a hak angket; Gerindra asks Kemendikdasmen and KPU to explain publicly and says the VP's status follows constitutional mechanisms; KPU says election stages are already complete; Mahfud MD says the suket's creation should be processed criminally.
events.key_numbers: PKB (Muhammad Khozin, Komisi II) in talks with other factions and the civil-society alliance AKSI (Ray Rangkuti) · Gerindra spokesperson Sugiat Santoso (Deputy Chair Komisi XIII) · reactions published 30-31 Oct 2026 · PKB has not chosen hak angket or pemakzulan · no Istana/Gibran response to the MA ruling found
events.why_it_matters: Shows how DPR factions are positioning on a possible hak angket or other step; a political fight is forming over a court ruling.
events.spreading_evidence: Several outlets run party-reaction pieces 30-31 Oct

events.event: The Attorney General's Office (Kejagung) searched PT IPPS offices in a transfer-pricing corruption case involving PT Toba Pulp Lestari, per CNN Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Search reported 30 Oct 2026 20:01 · case: transfer pricing · details (amounts, suspects) not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Another big-company probe by Kejagung, running alongside KPK's cukai probe.

events.event: DPR Commission III's Panja for the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset) says investment and pyramid-scheme provisions are covered in the draft.
events.why_it_matters: Shows what the asset forfeiture law could reach and how far the bill has come.

events.event: BNPB says it plans to overhaul disaster-fund governance after a suspected corruption case at the agency (the DSP emergency-fund case).
events.key_numbers: Statement 30 Oct 2026 · KPK named five suspects on 18 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Disaster aid money is what affected families depend on; a corruption case prompts a governance fix.

events.event: Jakarta Tipikor Court holds the next hearing in the trial of former Deputy Minister Silmy Karim and seven officials, the day the defence is due to file its objection (eksepsi) to the indictment.
events.key_numbers: Thu 5 Nov 2026, 10.00 · indictment: extortion Rp168.9 billion, gratification Rp33.8 billion · Silmy alleged to have received Rp1.2 billion · 7 defendants (Silmy plus seven officials per Suara Merdeka)
events.why_it_matters: A former deputy minister's court case on alleged extortion over foreigners' residence permits moves to the next stage; the 'RAMA' code is a hook.
